name: nuit blanche;
source:
Narcisse is a 19 year-old young man who suffers from chronic insomnia. Alas, that is not his only problem: he suffers from anxiety, he is a virgin (which is apparently a problem), he drags the shackles of trauma behind him… He just wishes his body would function normally.

But one day, Narcisse finds the answer to his prayer: international sensation Gabriel Howell. And he needs him in his life… at all costs.

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/nuit-blanche]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
纳西斯是一名饱受慢性失眠折磨的19岁青年。可叹他的烦恼远不止于此：他患有焦虑症，至今还是个处男（这显然也是个大问题），身后还拖着沉重的心理创伤枷锁……他只盼着自己的身体能恢复正常运转。

直到某一天，纳西斯终于找到了回应他祈祷的救星——享誉国际的风云人物加布里埃尔·豪厄尔。他必须让这个人走进自己的生命里……不惜一切代价。

[摘自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/nuit-blanche]itch.io[/url]]
